digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate and operator-attested evidence contract
propositions: Operator-attested evidence lacking measurement provenance (environment, principal, privilege_posture, instrument type) creates structural gate blindness where measurements appear green despite observable failure modes they cannot detect
A deterministic check in det_measurement_provenance.py must flag missing provenance fields with zero LLM, mirroring det_floor.py, enforced through text presence on [operator-attested] criteria

Privilege posture alone cannot distinguish a simulator from a live call; both can honestly declare production-equivalent privilege, so instrument type (live-call|simulation|static-analysis) is a required fourth field to catch wrong authorization conclusions

Plans citing only configuration changes while asserting unchanged behavior across provider/route/model swaps create invisible defects because uncited resolution paths (resolve_model, verify.py, orchestrator.finalize_verdict) are never exercised or reviewed
The advisory criterion ships in .rebar/ project overlay at block_threshold 0.9 with trigger text_all [\[operator-attested\]], leaving shipped default criteria unchanged per ADR-0054

Completion-verifier is explicitly NOT redesigned to re-run world measurements; the contract forces measurement context into the record as text so repo-grounded machinery finds contradictions, matching existing gate strengths
